strengths.point: Profit compounding has been strong over five years.
Return on capital employed is comfortably healthy.
Operating margin has widened over the last few years.
Sales compounding has been strong over five years.

strengths.point: The reserves trend has been rising for 6 years in a row.
Leverage is modest and easily serviced.
The sales trend has been rising for 4 quarters in a row.

weaknesses.point: Operating cash flow is negative while the company books a profit.
The share price has run ahead of the fundamentals.
Borrowings have climbed sharply over the last few years.
Operating profit converts poorly into cash.
Costs are rising faster than sales.
Receivables tie up a lot of cash.
Cash stays locked in the working-capital cycle for a long time.
The DCF puts intrinsic value below the market price.
